promotion.promotion_gate: At least one real pull request must show capital-ai-ci PASS before this expected policy is promoted to a live GitHub ruleset.
promotion.rollback: Disable or edit the ruleset if any required check becomes missing, ambiguous, skipped unexpectedly, or failing without a documented cause. Preserve normal PR workflow and repair on a fresh branch.
promotion.decision_2026-08-14: Owner decided both capital-ai-ci and build-and-test are required, not capital-ai-ci alone, so the existing Human/Owner comment-gate (checkbox attestations + head-bound review in ci.yml owner-gate/build-and-test) remains a server-enforced merge condition and is not silently dropped by the capital-ai-ci-shadow.yml migration. See docs/evidence/security/SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-08-14_ADR0069_DEVELOPMENT_CHAIN.md, Befund P1-1.
promotion.decision_2026-08-14b: Owner created the live ruleset with deletion_protection deliberately left disabled: in the current single-owner topology, enabling it forced a bypass actor entry to remain administrable, which would itself reintroduce a bypass exception. Accepted residual risk: main can currently be deleted without a ruleset block. Revisit once a second trusted reviewer identity exists (see single_owner_topology.promotion_condition). Owner also enabled require_code_owner_review; .github/CODEOWNERS received a `* @SvenKulessa` catch-all the same day so the rule covers paths beyond the previously explicit list.
promotion.decision_2026-08-14c: GitHub Advanced Security CodeQL was evaluated against the already-active Snyk Code check (context code/snyk) and found redundant for SAST coverage (both do semantic source-code vulnerability analysis; Snyk Code needs no GitHub Actions runtime, matching ADR-0070's no-new-workflow design). Owner decided against CodeQL as a required check. GitGuardian Security Checks and both Snyk contexts (security/snyk, code/snyk) passed on three independent head-bound pull requests (#249, #250, #251), exceeding ADR-0070's two-head promotion gate, and were promoted to required checks with Owner approval. See docs/evidence/security/GITGUARDIAN_SNYK_BASELINE_2026-08-14.md.

single_owner_topology.rationale: A mandatory independent GitHub approval would deadlock the current single-owner repository. HIGH/CRITICAL agent actions remain subject to CAPITAL-AI capability, approval and step-up controls until an independent reviewer exists.
single_owner_topology.promotion_condition: Enable at least one independent approving review, deletion_protection and a bypass-free enforcement posture when a distinct trusted reviewer identity is available.
